title: Interview scheduling software pricing
description: Cadence pricing: a Free plan for core scheduling and a per-workspace Team plan that adds ATS sync, no-show defense, and SLA nudges.

faq.a: Cadence has a Free plan and a paid Team plan, billed per workspace. Core scheduling, calendar sync, candidate links, dashboards, CSV import, and GDPR tooling are free; the Team plan adds Greenhouse and Lever sync, no-show defense, and SLA nudges. Candidates never need an account and are never a billable seat.

Early-access workspaces moved to the Free plan when billing launched, with nothing deleted and nothing switched on silently. Upgrading to Team is a single checkout from workspace settings, with billing handled by Freemius as merchant of record.

faq.q: Is there a limit on candidates or interviews?
faq.a: No hard caps are applied; fair-use rate limits protect the platform but do not constrain normal recruiting volumes.
